name: AR Orchestrator
fn: Routes work across cash app, collections, dispute and deduction agents
detail: Routes work across the cash-app, collections, dispute and deduction agents according to policy — e.g. a short-pay carrying a deduction code flows from cash app to deductions to disputes. Makes the modules act as one O2C workforce.
sap: SAP S/4HANA · FI-AR · CDS analytical views · BAPI / IDoc integration
